title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23045v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web search agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong promise, but deep research tasks expose a recurring failure mode: once an agent has produced a query, plan, or intermediate conclusion, it becomes less objective when later judging the consequences of that same action. We term this phenomenon \textbf{inertia bias}. To make it measurable, we introduce the IBIS benchmark, which controls the search observations while varying whether the model is evaluating the outcome of its own prior action. We find that models are substantially worse when they ``own'' the preceding search step, showing that self-authored action history can systematically distort subsequent judgment. We further show that this bias propagates into two forms of system-level degradation: search noise at the worker level and contextual noise at the manager level. translated_title: 从惯性到客观性：通过噪声隔离改进深度研究智能体
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23045v1 公告类型：新 摘要：由大型语言模型（LLMs）驱动的网络搜索智能体展现出巨大潜力，但深度研究任务暴露出一个反复出现的失败模式：一旦智能体生成了查询、计划或中间结论，它在后续判断同一行为后果时会变得不那么客观。我们将此现象称为\textbf{惯性偏差}。为了使其可测量，我们引入了IBIS基准，该基准在控制搜索观察的同时，改变模型是否评估其自身先前行为的结果。我们发现，当模型“拥有”前一步搜索步骤时，其表现会显著变差，表明自我生成的行动历史会系统性地扭曲后续判断。我们进一步证明，这种偏差会传播为两种系统级退化：工作级别的搜索噪声和管理级别的上下文噪声。为解决此问题，我们提出了NIS-Agent，它在两个决策点应用上下文隔离。
tldr: 本文首次识别并量化了深度研究智能体中的“惯性偏差”现象，并提出NIS-Agent通过上下文隔离机制有效缓解该偏差，从而提升搜索智能体的客观性和性能。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies and quantifies "inertia bias" in deep research agents, and proposes NIS-Agent with context isolation to mitigate it, enhancing objectivity and performance.
